## Track I: isoenergetic KAM, confinement, restricted three-body problem

### isoenergetic_kam

[`KAM.Iso.isoenergetic_kam`](../KAM/Frozen/Iso/Theorems/IsoenergeticKam.lean#L44) · ✅ proved and sealed

I-G1: canonical isoenergetic a-posteriori KAM, HL19 Theorem 3.6 and Remark 3.7. Uniformization fixes the ray, its endpoint margin, and an upper bound for gamma first. The energy conclusion is pointwise, by invariance and nonresonance, not merely averaged.

- **Source:** HL19 Theorem 3.6 and Remark 3.7, pp. 18–19 (statement.md §I-G1)
- **Proof assembled in:** `KAM.Provider.Iso.IsoenergeticKam`
- **Manifest ID:** `iso.isoenergetic_kam.v1`

### all_time_confinement

[`KAM.Iso.all_time_confinement`](../KAM/Frozen/Iso/Theorems/AllTimeConfinement.lean#L45) · ✅ proved and sealed

I-HEAD: all-time action confinement in two degrees of freedom, derived from I-G1, energy-cylinder separation and ODE continuation; not a verbatim HL19 theorem. Every local solution through the initial point agrees with the exhibited global one.

- **Source:** statement.md §I-HEAD (our deduction: KAM tori separate the energy surface)
- **Proof assembled in:** `KAM.Provider.Iso.AllTimeConfinement`

N-ZERO: exact all-time integrable dynamics. This is our explicit zero-perturbation supplement to BM Theorem 2.1 p. 5, whose printed strict bound excludes `ε = 0`.

- **Proof assembled in:** `KAM.Provider.Nekhoroshev.ZeroPerturbation`

### quasiConvex_nekhoroshev_complexBound

[`KAM.Nekhoroshev.quasiConvex_nekhoroshev_complexBound`](../KAM/Frozen/Nekhoroshev/Theorems/QuasiConvexNekhoroshevComplexBound.lean#L47) · ✅ proved and sealed

N-HEAD-C: a separate source-input variant using Pöschel 1993, Theorem 1, pp. 190--191. Both new bounds precede the constants. `Mcomplex` supplies the complex Hessian bound; `ωmin` supplies quantitative quasi-convexity and excludes Theorem 1's low-frequency exception. The frequency upper bound required by its time prefactor follows from the retained real `B(M)`. All conversions and source-line anchors are given in docs/tracks/N/sources.md. This is a new proposal; the approved N-HEAD declaration above is unchanged.

- **Source:** Pöschel 1993 Theorem 1, pp. 190–191, via BM11 Theorem 2.1, p. 5 (statement.md §N-HEAD-C)
- **Proof assembled in:** `KAM.Provider.Nekhoroshev.QuasiConvexNekhoroshevComplexBound`
- **Manifest ID:** `nekhoroshev.quasiConvex_nekhoroshev_complexBound.v1`

### partialConvex_nekhoroshev

[`KAM.Nekhoroshev.partialConvex_nekhoroshev`](../KAM/Frozen/Nekhoroshev/Theorems/PartialConvexNekhoroshev.lean#L48) · ✅ proved and sealed

N-PARTIAL-CONVEX. Fixed h, complex Hessian bound and domains precede the threshold, which is uniform in the normalized perturbation and supplied interval. The slow-domain condition is tested only through the queried time, never assumed through the exponential window. Source: Nekhoroshev 1977, Theorem 4.4, p. 30. The enlarged source tube contains the working domain with a fixed collar. Use the definite-Hessian proof of Lemma 10.6, then the printed proof of Theorem 4.4; do not assert literal global source steepness at boundary centres. See notes.md.

- **Source:** N-PARTIAL-CONVEX: Nekhoroshev 1977 Theorem 4.4 p. 30 with Remarks 4.5.A–B, convex specialization on the enlarged fast domain
- **Proof assembled in:** `KAM.Provider.Nekhoroshev.PartialConvexNekhoroshev`
- **Manifest ID:** `nekhoroshev.d25.partialConvex_nekhoroshev.v1`

### averaging_mean

[`KAM.Nekhoroshev.averaging_mean`](../KAM/Frozen/Nekhoroshev/Theorems/AveragingMean.lean#L44) · ✅ proved and sealed

N-AVERAGING-MEAN, analytic Hamiltonian specialization of AKN06 p.243 (6.27)--(6.28). AKN Theorem 6.11 and Corollary 6.1 for genuine solution families. The flow premise is only typing/existence on the stated interval; there is no hypothesis about its error or about an exceptional set. Constants are chosen after the fixed analytic system and compact initial set, before ε, the solution family, and κ. Measure is unnormalized phase volume.

- **Source:** AKN06 Theorem 6.11 (6.27), p. 243; Nei76 Theorem 1
- **Proof assembled in:** `KAM.Provider.Nekhoroshev.AveragingMean`
- **Manifest ID:** `nekhoroshev.d28.averaging_mean.v1`

### averaging_most

[`KAM.Nekhoroshev.averaging_most`](../KAM/Frozen/Nekhoroshev/Theorems/AveragingMost.lean#L44) · ✅ proved and sealed

N-AVERAGING-MOST, derived from AKN06 p.243 and Neishtadt 1976 pp.1295--1298. Local-domain, actual-solution consequence of AKN (6.28). Existence and confinement are conclusions on the good data, not premises. The source smoothness convention is AKN06 p.3 footnote 1; the averaged-orbit collar is Remark 6.4, pp.217--218. Neishtadt Theorem 2 includes existence in its good-data definition; notes.md gives the stopped proof plan and corrects the maximum-error step. No flow or future confinement is assumed here.

- **Source:** AKN06 Corollary 6.1 (6.28), p. 243; Nei76 Theorem 2 (8), p. 1296
- **Proof assembled in:** `KAM.Provider.Nekhoroshev.AveragingMost`
- **Manifest ID:** `nekhoroshev.d28.averaging_most.v1`
